name: saipan-ivf
description: Multilingual Saipan IVF website built with Astro components, TypeScript and MDX.

scripts.build:demo: node scripts/with-env.mjs INCLUDE_DRAFTS=1 REVIEW=0 astro build
scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:content && pnpm run validate:policy && pnpm run validate:seo && pnpm run validate:claims
scripts.ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run validate:content && pnpm run validate:policy && pnpm run validate:claims && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run validate:seo && pnpm run links && pnpm run guardrails && pnpm run audit
scripts.dev:demo: node scripts/with-env.mjs INCLUDE_DRAFTS=1 REVIEW=0 astro dev
